text:
Ethan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: can we confirm messaging for API / Console / Optimize timelines? Sales asked for a one-liner and CS wants a short FAQ. Main asks: model pinning + rollout UI window, Optimize suggestions export + apply flow, streaming+function-calls GA ETA.

Rina: Short update so teams can communicate: model pinning + rollout UI -> internal canary in mid-August, public beta late-August, GA target conditional on canary (aiming Aug-end). Optimize (Console suggestion UI) -> preview in early Sept; export/API for suggestions and opt-in apply -> targeting late Sept/early Oct. Streaming + function-calls -> feature-flag GA in ~4 weeks (pending docs).

Olga: Heads up: rollout UI depends on traffic-slice changes (ENG-2310). There's a live perf flake affecting shard balancing; I'm pairing with runtime tomorrow. If that slips, public beta moves by ~2 weeks.

Ben: For external comms we should avoid exact dates until canary is green. Suggested customer blurb: "Planned windows: rollout UI late August (beta first), Optimize console preview in September with API export to follow. We'll confirm GA dates after canary and QA."

Ethan: Can someone drop a 1-2 line internal note I can forward to SDRs and AMs? They want copy-paste content.

Rina: Internal pasteable: "Timeline snapshot: rollout UI (canary mid-Aug -> beta late Aug -> GA after canary), Optimize console preview in Sept; suggestion export and opt-in apply in late Sept/Oct. Streaming+function-calls will reach feature-flag GA within ~4 weeks. Precise dates pending infra gating."

Olga: Debug snippet if you want to repro the shard issue: ```kubectl -n platform exec deploy/traffic-slice -- curl -s localhost:9000/debug | jq '.shard_stats'``` . Ping me if you need access.

Ben: Rollback/guards: rollout UI will be behind per-org flags and an automatic fallback to previous routing if p50 latency exceeds SLA for 5m. We also have a rate-limited ramp for public beta.

Ethan: Perfect. Rina, can you post this as a short RFC and tag product/docs/CS? Also tag infra so we can watch ENG-2310.

Rina: Will do. RFC tonight and I'll ping the channels.

release-bot: Canary window reserved: 2024-08-04 -> 2024-08-11. Reservation: <https://redwood.internal/releases/1825009876|canary-window> :spiral_calendar:
